judged_text: The Office365 refresh previously logged a zod parse failure and proceeded with the stale credentials; the new parseRefreshTokenResponse path throws 'Invalid refreshed tokens were returned' on any parse failure, changing the failure semantics for existing behavior. A single malformed provider token response now throws out of refreshAccessToken where before it degraded to the old token and logged, converting previously-survivable transient provider errors into hard booking-path failures for Outlook users.

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the diff replaces `refreshTokenResponseSchema.safeParse(responseJson)` (which logged on failure and continued with the existing `o365AuthCredentials`) with `parseRefreshTokenResponse(responseJson, refreshTokenResponseSchema)`. The new helper (`packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`) explicitly `throw`s when `safeParse` fails (`throw new Error("Invalid refreshed tokens were returned")`), so the refresh path now errors out instead of degrading to stale credentials + logging. This is a real, diff-grounded change in failure semantics that could increase hard failures, but it may be intentional rather than an inherent correctness bug.
